name: PubChem Peptides
description: Peptide compounds extracted from PubChem. Each record includes PubChem CID, peptide title/name, one-letter amino acid sequence, HELM notation, PLN notation, IUPAC name, condensed IUPAC name, and SMILES representation.

data_schema.title: PubChem Peptide Record
data_schema.description: One row of the PubChem Peptides TSV — a single peptide compound from PubChem.

HELM.description: HELM (Hierarchical Editing Language for Macromolecules) notation.

metadata.format: TSV (CID, Title, Sequence, HELM, PLN, IUPAC, IUPAC_Condensed, SMILES)
metadata.full_dataset_size: ~115M compounds in PubChem; peptide subset depends on filtering criteria
metadata.citation: Kim S, Chen J, Cheng T, et al. PubChem 2023 update. Nucleic Acids Res. 2023 Jan 6;51(D1):D1373-D1380.
